summary: CR-385 Phase 1 QA @ 1920x1080 on preprod (OWNER_TGK / restaurant #69). Focused on M7 (Channel Manager 'Front Desk Rules' tab + settings write shape) and M2 read-only + XOR checks (row actions, drawer -exp- infix, No-Show inline). Found and FIXED one BLOCKER (BLK-M7-CT): updateFrontDeskRules was posting application/json instead of multipart/form-data because the shared axios instance defaults Content-Type to 'application/json' and FormData was being JSON-stringified (body captured as `{"data":"{\"basic\":{...}}"}`). After adding an explicit `headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }` on the POST, the request is now proper multipart with a single 'data' field whose JSON equals `{basic:{allow_early_checkin,extend_rate_mode}}`. Reload persistence verified, final state ended at documented defaults (allow_early_checkin=false, extend_rate_mode=calendar). Test bookings (M2-2/3/4/5/6) NOT executed — legacy /pms/new-booking creation flow was out of budget and inspected existing sandbox data already contains rows using r2/r3 (violates the r4/r5/r1 rule) so main agent should handle those flows manually.

integration_issues.issue: Before fix, body was application/json '{"data":"<json string>"}' not multipart/form-data. Root cause: shared axios instance in /app/frontend/src/api/axios.js sets default Content-Type: application/json and updateFrontDeskRules did not override it — axios then serialized FormData as JSON. FIXED in /app/frontend/src/api/services/restaurantSettingsService.js by adding explicit `headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }`. Server accepted both shapes so data still persisted on preprod, but the wire shape now matches the QA spec.

critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKER (FIXED): restaurantSettingsService.updateFrontDeskRules omitted the multipart Content-Type header. Because the shared axios instance defaults to application/json, axios serialised FormData to `{"data":"<stringified json>"}`. The pattern must be replicated cautiously — updateSettings has the same latent bug.

Consider centralising a `postMultipart(url, formData)` helper in api/axios.js to remove the boilerplate `headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' }` from every service and prevent future recurrences.

FrontDeskRulesTab has good testability (all testids present) but the switch/radio inputs are visually hidden by the mt-1 offset and depend on `accent-*` colouring — this makes them harder to click programmatically. A future refactor to use a proper Switch component would remove force=True requirements from tests.

ArrivalsPanel.actions(row, variant) elegantly generates -exp- infixed testids in the drawer and enforces the OTA-vs-Direct XOR via nsOrCancel(row). Verified in the DOM: 10 rows all have correct action mix.

rca of the issue: BLK-M7-CT: updateFrontDeskRules built a FormData and called api.post(url, formData). Axios' default request `Content-Type: application/json` (set in api/axios.js) was not overridden, so axios' JSON transform ran on the FormData object. The resulting body was `{"data":"{\"basic\":{...}}"}` on the wire, not multipart. Preprod backend happened to accept both shapes so persistence tests would have PASSED functionally, but the QA spec explicitly required multipart/form-data. Fix: add `{ headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } }` as the 3rd argument to `api.post`. Verified: request now leaves the browser as `multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary…` with a single `data` field.
